---
title: "UMD Data Science: Schedule"
page-layout: full
---

This page contains the schedule and links for lectures, activities, homework,
and common_code. It is generated automatically from `_schedule.yml` — to
reorder weeks or modules, edit that file. This page never needs to change.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (!requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("yaml")
library(yaml)

schedule <- yaml::read_yaml("_schedule.yml")

# null-coalesce helper (works on any R version, in case %||% isn't in base yet)
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# label + emoji for each kind of link, in the order they should appear
link_types <- list(
  lecture     = list(emoji = "🖥️", label = "Lecture"),
  activity    = list(emoji = "📋", label = "Activity"),
  homework    = list(emoji = "💻", label = "Homework"),
  assignment  = list(emoji = "📝", label = "Assignment"),
  common_code = list(emoji = "📖", label = "Common Code")
)

cat('::::::::::::::::::: column-screen-inset-right\n\n')

for (wk in schedule$weeks) {

  heading <- paste0("Week ", wk$week, if (nzchar(wk$title %||% "")) paste0(": ", wk$title) else "")
  cat("###", heading, "\n\n")
  cat('::: {layout-ncol="2"}\n\n')

  for (mod in wk$modules) {
    topic_line <- if (nzchar(mod$topic %||% "")) paste("-", mod$topic) else "-"
    cat("####", mod$number, topic_line, "\n\n")

    for (key in names(link_types)) {
      path <- mod[[key]]
      if (!is.null(path)) {
        info <- link_types[[key]]
        cat(sprintf("- [%s %s](%s)\n", info$emoji, info$label, path))
      }
    }
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat(":::\n\n---\n\n")
}

cat(':::::::::::::::::::\n')
```
